name: TMX Tribe Router-minted USDG inflates TLP AUM
summary: TMX, a GMX-v1 fork on Arbitrum, made its public Router a manager of the Vault, so any user could mint USDG through Router.swap([token, USDG]). GlpManager prices TLP as pool AUM divided by TLP supply and does not subtract USDG minted outside GlpManager, so each such mint raised the TLP redemption price while the minted USDG stayed redeemable 1:1. The attacker looped mintAndStakeGlp, a Router USDG mint, unstakeAndRedeemGlp at the inflated price and sellUSDG, draining the Vault's USDT0, WBTC, WETH, wSOL and USDC.

loss.notes: Components are the Vault's net ERC-20 outflow to the two attacker EOAs across all 445 successful attacker transactions that touched it (blocks 417530153-418024535): tokens the Vault sent them minus the tokens they deposited, so attacker-supplied loop capital is not counted and fees retained by the Vault reduce the figure. USDG nets to zero (minted and burned). The Jan 3-4 test runs from 0x16ed3aff lost 12.642473 USDT0 to the Vault and drew 0.00010844 WBTC; they are netted into the totals. Prices are DefiLlama historical quotes at the last Vault-touching transaction (timestamp 1767583146). The total matches the ~$1.4M reported by DarkNavy and QuillAudits. Later swaps, bridging and laundering by the attacker are not loss events.

ageReset.description: ProxyAdmin 0x3afdbef553d5c92817da37096bb2e47daeef951d.upgrade by the deployer selected Vault implementation 0x7f68594c7e9919c88e88fcd00b7f786cd6f45804, the code whose buyUSDG admitted the Router-manager mint in the anchor; it stayed active until block 419144004. The causal setting isManager(Router)=true was written earlier, at block 394937076 (Timelock tx 0x830d8cb8d863d057719d883bd6e3cb2f23b7a8a53792fff7b05c8c60e30a69d0, storage slot 0x67097c88c14e77814f8da4a2b94e1057d2715ac7351e8f248cb988361be24f05 0 -> 1), so this later code activation is the latest reset.

limitations: Vault, Router and GlpManager implementations are unverified on Arbiscan; attribution rests on traces, view calls and storage diffs plus the DarkNavy analysis rather than source code.

GlpManager 0xe80fb6f907b37e2ed46a634882420b8e21bccfb1 (impl 0x2141dc7e3a50d177cdeadfb59fa50ffb17cd43d7, active since block 394932346), whose AUM omits external USDG, is not executed by the anchor and is not a separate target; its activation and the Router implementation activation (block 395320426) both precede this knot.

sources.note: Anchor: eth_getTransactionReceipt(source-1) = block 417530153, tx index 5, status 1, from 0x16ed3aff3255fddb44daa73b4de06f0c2e15288d (EOA funded with 0.02 ETH by main attacker 0x763a67e4418278f84c04383071fc00165c112661 in tx 0x3e04f6ffdd0ac039afc7a9a8026e47432f22bf3a0860121b776520ffe46b7136), to Router proxy 0x18f340f493f37869fcdbb9565767b00f18b9e425, calldata swap(address[],uint256,uint256,address) selector 0x6023e966 with path [USDT0 0xfd086bc7cd5c481dcc9c85ebe478a1c0b69fcbb9, USDG 0x9ec1f9f46636c293d03aca25124749c231b1d598], amountIn 3000000. callTracer: Router proxy -> impl 0x3c4d72aa4b4a39755fe6fdcdb4a80d07529f765a -> CALL Vault proxy 0x67af542d497e302f576d5aabd60bc39c3e8e1cb4 buyUSDG(address,address) 0x817bb857 -> DELEGATECALL impl 0x7f68594c7e9919c88e88fcd00b7f786cd6f45804; log 11 USDT0 3000000 attacker->Vault, log 16 USDG mint 2974500000000000000 to 0x16ed3aff, log 17 Vault BuyUSDG (topic 0xab4c77c74cd32c85f35416cf03e7ce9e2d4387f7b7f2c1f4bf53daaecf8ea72d). At block 417530152 Vault inManagerMode()=true, isManager(Router)=true, isManager(0x16ed3aff)=false: the Router's manager privilege lets any caller mint USDG. Earliest exercise: Etherscan getLogs of BuyUSDG on the Vault from its creation (block 394932037) to 418200000 returns 1133 events with account = GlpManager proxy 0xe80fb6f907b37e2ed46a634882420b8e21bccfb1 (normal TLP mints) and only two other receivers: 0x16ed3aff (17 events, first = source-1) and 0x763a67e4 (87 events, first 0x546776ebd9a5c0ab58e6ee26934455fb9b05dfe5d7c23844207a3c323f4ad4e5 at 417991203). No non-GlpManager USDG mint precedes source-1. The 0x16ed3aff runs of Jan 3-4 (3 to 18 USDT0 per leg) are the attacker's tests; the first profitable cycle is source-7: mintAndStakeGlp 55109.954699 USDT0 -> 54286.122435187440186374 fsTLP; Router buyUSDG 82664.932049 USDT0 -> 81962.280126 USDG; unstakeAndRedeemGlp 54286.122435187440186374 TLP -> 57323.679447 USDT0; sellUSDG 81962.280126 USDG -> 81962.280126 USDT0; net +1511.072825 USDT0. Root cause (view calls on GlpManager proxy 0xe80fb6f9, impl 0x2141dc7e3a50d177cdeadfb59fa50ffb17cd43d7): getAumInUsdg(true) 1659731.389167297273299816e18 at block 417991202 -> 1741693.669293297273299816e18 at 417991203, delta exactly 81962.280126e18 = the USDG minted to 0x763a in 0x546776eb; TLP totalSupply unchanged at 1648936.216696552193914122e18; Vault usdgAmounts(USDT0) and USDG totalSupply both +81962.280126e18. GlpManager prices TLP as AUM/supply and never deducts USDG held outside GlpManager, so every externally minted USDG raises TLP's redemption price while remaining redeemable 1:1 via sellUSDG. GlpManager inPrivateMode=true and cooldownDuration=0 at 417530152. This matches DarkNavy (source-8): AUM 'ignores USDG liabilities'. Reports of a ProxyAdmin/deployer compromise (source-12) are not supported onchain: ProxyAdmin 0x3afdbef553d5c92817da37096bb2e47daeef951d has a single OwnershipTransferred (to deployer 0x33392e39325013e81874ca7b76326858ec179543), no AdminChanged beyond creation on the Vault/GlpManager/Router/RewardRouter proxies, every Upgraded tx is sent by that deployer and the attacker only called public Router/RewardRouter functions. Loss: fetched all 614 transactions sent by 0x763a67e4 and 0x16ed3aff (Etherscan txlist) and their receipts; 445 successful ones move ERC-20 into or out of the Vault. Vault Transfer counterparties in them are only the two EOAs, GlpManager (USDG) and the zero address (USDG mint/burn; USDG nets to 0). An Etherscan getLogs Transfer scan Vault<->each EOA over blocks 417400000-418300000 finds no transfer outside these attacker transactions. Net Vault outflow (out minus attacker inputs) = components; 0x16ed3aff's share is -12.642473 USDT0 and +0.00010844 WBTC (a net gain to the Vault), 0x763a's share is 846008.846491 USDT0, 3.43756066 WBTC, 67.005889147441234268 WETH, 340.788244319 wSOL, 828.809777 USDC. Last Vault-touching tx 0xc3d66957ea5b90d9e3f4d8fa43f29cd2cd4147a15de42d4f33bb301c4d2bad68 block 418024535 idx 6, timestamp 1767583146. Router proxy was upgraded by the deployer at block 418078285 afterwards.
